mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_flow_message where receiver = #{receiver} and read_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into pm_flow_message(receiver, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, instance_id, read_flag, create_time) values(#{receiver}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{instanceId}, '0', sysdate())
